title: JSON API query
description: One read of a JSON HTTP API, as data: an RFC 6570 URI template, the template variables every call shares, and RFC 6901 pointers to the result list and the total count in the response. Calling an API needs its query, not a client script.

variables.description: Template variables every call shares; a call's own variables override them.

results.description: RFC 6901 pointer to the response's result array.

count.description: RFC 6901 pointer to the response's total count of matches.
